services.name: Full Sail
services.desc: Whether you're curious about sailing or just looking for a meaningful way to spend time outside, BIPOC Sailing Nights are designed to create a welcoming and affirming space. Participants can learn, connect, and simply enjoy being out on the water with other People of Color. BIPOC Sailing events remove barriers to access and increase representation in a sport that hasn't always been inclusive. BIPOC Sailing Nights, held monthly from May - September, provide a dedicated space for Black, Indigenous, and People of Color to explore sailing, build community, and enjoy time of the water in an environment where you can truly feel at ease. services.name: Private Lessons
services.desc: Looking for a personalized sailing experience? We offer private lessons and class sessions tailored to you or your small group. Whether you're seeking a fun family adventure, want to refine specific skills, or need a class that fits your schedule, we're here to help! Our lessons are held on our J22s and Sonars, with accommodations available for adaptive sailors. Private lessons are the perfect way for beginner sailors to learn at their own pace or for DSC members to sharpen specific skills, such as preparing for a skipper checkout. Tailored to your needs, these lessons help you build confidence and achieve your sailing goals! Prices above are the total per boat per hour based on occupancy.

services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: The DSC summer sailing camp offers a unique experience in Baltimore's Inner Harbor. Whether your child is new to sailing or looking to hone their racing skills, our flexible programs cater to all levels of experience. With a low staff-to-camper ratio, each child receives personalized instruction tailored to their skill level. Let your child discover the joy of sailing at the DSC this summer! Beginner Sailing Camp is ideal for kids and teens looking to try sailing for the first time or returning campers wanting to refine their basic skills. Each boat is staffed with one instructor and accommodates four to six campers. Friends attending together can request to be placed on the same boat crew.
